description: Deduplicate event records that may arrive multiple times due to at-least-once delivery. For each (user_id, event_name, session_id) group, keep only the first occurrence by event_timestamp. If two events have identical timestamps, break ties by event_id (lower wins). The output should preserve all original columns. Output columns: all columns from the events table.

event_id.description: Primary key (auto-increment, not guaranteed unique across replays)

ingestion_timestamp.description: When this record was ingested (may differ from event_timestamp)

edge_cases: Identical timestamps requiring tie-breaking by event_id
Different properties for same logical event (take the first by timestamp/event_id)
NULL session_id (should be treated as a distinct group)
common_failure_modes: FM3: Using DISTINCT instead of ROW_NUMBER partitioning
FM5: Not handling NULL session_id in partition
